Package net.paulhertz.pixelaudio.sampler

Class PlaybackInfo

java.lang.Object
net.paulhertz.pixelaudio.sampler.PlaybackInfo
public class PlaybackInfo extends Object
Holds information about a triggered playback event. Returned by PASharedBufferSampler.play(), where it can be used for debugging.

      public PlaybackInfo(long voiceId, int eventSamples, float bufferReadSamples, float durationMS, boolean looping, long startSample, float sampleRate)
      Creates playback information for a triggered voice.
      Parameters:
      voiceId - unique sampler voice identifier
      eventSamples - duration in output samples
      bufferReadSamples - number of source buffer samples traversed
      durationMS - duration in milliseconds
      looping - true when the voice loops indefinitely
      startSample - absolute start time in samples
      sampleRate - output sample rate in Hz

  • Method Details

    • computeVoiceDuration

      public static int computeVoiceDuration(int samplePos, int sampleLen, int bufferLen, float pitch, ADSRParams env, boolean looping, float sampleRate)
      Computes total playback duration when source and output rates are equal. Envelope stage times are assumed to be in seconds.
      Parameters:
      samplePos - buffer index to start playback
      sampleLen - requested duration in source-buffer samples
      bufferLen - source buffer length in samples
      pitch - pitch or playback-rate multiplier
      env - optional ADSR envelope
      looping - true when playback loops indefinitely
      sampleRate - output sample rate in Hz
      Returns:
      duration in output samples (int), or Integer.MAX_VALUE if looping.

    • computeVoiceDuration

      public static int computeVoiceDuration(int samplePos, int sampleLen, int bufferLen, float pitch, ADSRParams env, boolean looping, float sampleRate, boolean wrapAround)
      Computes total playback duration (in output samples) with optional source-buffer wrapping.
      Parameters:
      samplePos - buffer index to start playback
      sampleLen - requested duration in source-buffer samples
      bufferLen - source buffer length in samples
      pitch - pitch or playback-rate multiplier
      env - optional ADSR envelope
      looping - true when playback loops indefinitely
      sampleRate - output sample rate in Hz
      wrapAround - true to preserve requested duration across source-buffer boundaries
      Returns:
      duration in output samples (int), or Integer.MAX_VALUE if looping.

    • computeVoiceDuration

      public static int computeVoiceDuration(int samplePos, int sampleLen, int bufferLen, float pitch, ADSRParams env, boolean looping, float bufferSampleRate, float outputSampleRate, boolean wrapAround)
      Computes rendered duration using distinct source-buffer and output clocks. The note window is measured in source-buffer samples; the result is measured in output samples because voices and envelopes advance once per output tick.
      Parameters:
      samplePos - source-buffer index at which playback begins
      sampleLen - requested note-window length in source-buffer samples
      bufferLen - source-buffer length in samples
      pitch - musical pitch ratio; 1.0 preserves source frequency
      env - optional ADSR envelope
      looping - true when playback loops indefinitely
      bufferSampleRate - intrinsic source-buffer sample rate in Hz
      outputSampleRate - audio output sample rate in Hz
      wrapAround - true to preserve the requested source length across the buffer boundary
      Returns:
      total duration in output samples, including release
